parent.parallel_external_science_lane: P84-MR #202 owns independent CausalGym first-use; no overlap or physical source execution

question: Can a truly continuous previously unseen action consequence be predicted from finitely observed action-consequence interventions with exactly a 16x16=256-float persistent fast memory, under stable and hidden within-episode changed mechanisms, versus a fully specified strong calibrated 256-float conventional update rule? If the conventional mechanism cannot learn the task, do not spend full-native-hybrid training budget or consume independent heldout evaluation.

data.generation: Per-world independently generated orthonormal rank-4 action subspace and effect subspace. Each actually executed action is independently drawn from the 16-dimensional continuous unit sphere (never repeated); its resulting observed effect is tanh(3.0 * (effect_basis @ action_basis.T @ executed_action)) with no measurement noise. Half the worlds use a single frozen causal matrix; half switch to a separately drawn independent rank-4 matrix after history event 24, without exposing a regime flag. All 48 historical actions and their observed effects are consumed in arrival order; only afterward a new independently sampled unit action query arrives with 16 zero unknown-effect features. The ground-truth query outcome is the current mechanism's effect, not available at write time.
data.intervention: The study specifies each executed action before its consequence, providing an actual simulated do(action)->effect rather than repeated exact-key lookup. No future target, change flag, evaluator role, or generated outcome enters memory prior to the corresponding action.
data.admission: FIT/CAL source identities and SHA256; confirm query action is not equal to an earlier action (all cosines<0.999), nonfinite/shape guards, confirm stable/change balance exactly 50/50, effects generated only from correct before/after mechanism and no future effect input. All world seeds disjoint from P65-P84 consumed cohorts; this author-synthetic mechanism is not an independently witnessed physical source.
data.sealed: Do not generate heldout_reserved or negative_reserved worlds unless a subsequent independently frozen experiment is eligible. This preflight only materializes FIT and CAL; no protected external first-use, no GPU.

controls.model_representations: All output vectors 16D. Any tested online fixed state exactly 256 float32 values per world; no hidden trainable parameters, cursor, per-action store or source feedback. Global fixed scalar learning rate/decay are protocol settings, not persistent per-world state.
controls.conventional_grid: Predeclared grid η∈{0.25,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0} × decay∈{1.0,0.99,0.97,0.95,0.90}; W starts all zeros; after observing executed action a_t (unit) and effect y_t, W := decay*W + η*(y_t-W@a_t)@a_t.T. Query predicts W@a_query. Calibrate one rule using CAL combined MSE (50% stable+50% change), freeze before heldout first-use; report separate stable/change outcomes and entire 25-rule calibration table. This selection is a CAL-trained conventional mechanism and must not be retrospectively reselected on heldout.
controls.original_P78: Exact previously pinned BoundedRawTTT η=0.5, decay1.0, 256-float state, must score identical to grid arm η=.5 decay1 up to floating precision; original source remains unchanged.
controls.zero: All-zero effect predictor; baseline per CAL regime.
controls.full_history_oracle: As diagnostic upper bound only, fit ridge linear map using up to last24 observed action/effect pairs via new (X^TX+1e-4 I) solution, using entire 24×(16+16)=768 float observed history and temporary matrix workspace; not memory-matched and never a contender for 256-float superiority.
controls.nearest_neighbor: As diagnostics only, retain all 48 action/effect events and return effect for closest action; 1536-float retained history, not comparable.
controls.original_full_hybrid: NOT TRAINED OR SCORED until conventional admission validates task. No model-integration or 'intelligence' claim from conventional preflight.

frozen_gate.preconditions: All source/audit and P78 original blob PASS; CAL 128 worlds perfectly split stable/change; no query equals any historical key, all observations finite; 256-element state exact; original P78 matches grid eta=.5 decay1 within 1e-7.
frozen_gate.baseline_competency: Selected CAL-grid conventional effect MSE <=0.75*zero MSE on STABLE AND <=0.80*zero MSE on CHANGED worlds, and <=0.80*zero combined. Nonmatching regime causes explicit FAIL, not selective successes. Last24 OLS must be more accurate than zero by >=25% in each regime (identifiability control). If any fail mark PRE_FLIGHT_FAIL, preserve all rows, do not generate heldout/negative, do not train hybrid.
frozen_gate.strong_control: For any future admission-qualified trained hybrid comparator require prospectively frozen identical FIT/CAL/heldout actions/effects, full native end-to-end training, 3 independent seeds, 256-float fast state, cold restoration and a 10% gain with paired bootstrap over this CAL-selected strongest conventional plus fully trained GRU/SSM matching capacity and compute. Stronger control exists and can falsify hypothesis.
frozen_gate.negative: Wrong-credit or causal-changepoint outcomes on reserved negative source will be materialized only in a subsequent qualified owner-isolated preregistration, not this baseline preflight.
frozen_gate.science_boundary: This is synthetic DEV evidence even on CAL pass. No protected external CartPole or physical first use, no autonomous cognitive claim, no RSI, no whole-process speed/efficiency proof.
